title: LICHEN test vector file
description: Combined envelope from parallel worker branches (incl. worker8,worker20,worker23; resolved project-LICHEN-9r55 merge-conflict in worktree-worker20: schema.json) for all LICHEN test vector files. Supports object with format_version enum[1,2] (v2 preferred, const=2 in most files), per-family docs (dedicated ccp15_document, ccp_load_balancing_document, rpl_route_state_document, dao_origin_signature_document etc.), bare array root (for ccp16-desync.json), strict required fields, additionalProperties:false, oneOf/allOf for per-vector variants to enforce independent oracles/test integrity only. See README.md.

oneOf.description: v2 bare array root (used by ccp16-desync.json for desync test vectors)

gateway_coordination_document.description: GCP vector family branch (gateway_coordination.json, gcp6_slot_coordination.json, rpl_multi_instance.json): enforces per-vector name/type/description key presence (project-LICHEN-worker6-jo3q/hik5).

gcp_vector.description: Gateway Coordination Protocol (GCP) vector: heterogeneous per-type payloads are allowed; the required keys guarantee every vector is identifiable and self-describing for cross-implementation consumers.

hex.description: Lowercase hex-encoded byte string (may be empty).

compressed.description: SCHC output: leading rule-id byte + residue + tail.

encoded.description: Announce app_data Type=0x01 bytes: type + signed big-endian lat_e7 + signed big-endian lon_e7.

body.description: Payload bytes after the dispatch byte.

wrapped.description: Authenticated link inner payload: dispatch byte + body.

oscore_vector.description: OSCORE (RFC 8613) test vector for key derivation, request/response protection, replay detection, or invalid input.

rpl_messages_vector.description: RPL control message (RFC 6550) parse/generate vector. Supports malformed ICMPv6/UDP cases with wire/expect_error per project-LICHEN-2auf.41.2.3.1 (checksum_failure, truncation).

type.description: Message or option type being tested

fields.description: Decoded message fields (structure varies by type)

wire.description: Full wire bytes for malformed test cases

expect_error.description: Expected error category for malformed vectors (checksum_failure, truncation)

expected_hash.description: hash_32(SFN, key) per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md §2a.7.1 (FNV-1a32 primitive, matches C lichen_hash_32 and Python _hash_32)

security_review.description: Pass 2 security: no injection or crypto issues in CCP-16 vectors (project-LICHEN-ray3)

now.description: now() u32 timestamp for TDMA cross-reference and monotonicity test

select_channel.description: Channel selected via hash_32(now() ^ iid) % num_channels

expected_hash.description: Output of hash_32 primitive (FNV-1a with basis 0x811c9dc5 per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:254; see Rust lichen-core::lichen_hash_32 + lichen-link::identity::hash_32, Python tests/test_vectors.py:_hash_32 for exact match. Matches no_std style)

peer_known.description: CCP-9 rendezvous: whether peer is known
